semantics: Roles use client-observed event history at submit or first run_batch entry. They do not establish when control delivery reached the runtime or its actual rank.
A report notice binds only its next noninternal epoch/request, expires after 120 seconds, and is invalidated by later tools/RETURN. Announced is not verified final.

A completion tool executed successfully without recorded stage events is an observability gap, not evidence that the child did not announce. Its report stage groups are marked stage_trace_unavailable, never reconstructed from future data.
Sole child is identified from already-returned siblings, not future RETURN times.
critical_queue_seconds uses the retrospectively last-returning member only for descriptive JOIN-path attribution. This label is never an online input.
Queue is native registration through first worker run_batch entry, not kernel start. Per-request sums can overlap across agents and are not removable JCT.
later_tool_requests is a retrospective outcome, not a ranking feature.
No unfavorable workflow, output-divergent request or long wait is discarded.
